name: Ferienwohnungen Konrad
beschreibung: The Konrad Holiday Apartments are located in the center of Söll in the Tiroler Unterland. The village lies at the foot of the Wilder Kaiser and is part of the SkiWelt Wilder Kaiser Brixental. Guests stay in practically furnished apartments with a kitchen and separate sleeping area. The ski bus stop is within a few minutes' walk. In summer, hiking trails start directly from the village into the Kaisergebirge.
